tv_results.name: Game of Thrones
tv_results.overview: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north. Amidst the war, a neglected military order of misfits, the Night's Watch, is all that stands between the realms of men and icy horrors beyond.

tv_episode_results.name: Place of Shadows
tv_episode_results.overview: A young man tries to insinuate his way into a monastery, in order to gain revenge on a thief whom he blames for ruining his life.
